method: Viewed each combined trajectory/tracking contact sheet through view_image, in seven batches of four; source PNG hashes are in inventory.json.
observations: All titles identify the matching C.3 task/method and full saved end 27.000 s. World axes/units, actual/reference/base curves and orange endpoint are visible. Tracking panels separate continuum generated-reference versus Task/base, rigid current grasp, and orientation in degrees; shaded task windows and full time axes are visible. No clipping or missing panels found. Transient error peaks (including D8-A test1_plus and R12-A test0_plus) are retained, not acceptance judgments.
limitations: Visual layout check only; CSV arithmetic and media/browser QA are separate.
